name: Model inventory attestation
description: Owners confirm each quarter that their entries in the model inventory are complete and current.

name: Drift dashboard
description: A drift dashboard tracks input and output distributions and notifies the model owner when they move beyond thresholds.

name: Chat answer review
description: A trained reviewer checks flagged chat answers in the human review queue.

name: Call recording retention
description: Retention of call recordings follows the legal schedule; it is not a change approval step.

name: Data centre badge review
description: Facilities reviews badge access to the data centre every quarter.

name: Spreadsheet inventory check
description: Annual check of the model inventory spreadsheet. Retired when the inventory moved to the platform.
